$schema.description: Path to schema.json, for editor completion.

args.description: Arguments added to every launch, before the ones you pass on the command line.

resumeExistingSession.description: Continue the stored session when the chosen worktree already has one.

sessionsDirectory.description: Where Claude Code stores sessions. Null means ~/.claude/projects.

color.description: Colored output. "auto" follows TTY detection and NO_COLOR.

enabled.description: Show the worktree picker on an interactive terminal.

message.description: Prompt shown above the worktree list.

maxItems.description: Worktrees visible before the list scrolls.

createWorktreeLabel.description: Label of the entry that creates a new worktree.

passthroughFlags.description: Arguments that mean the caller already chose a session, so the picker is skipped.

namePlaceholder.description: Placeholder shown in the name prompt.

args.description: Extra arguments used only when creating a worktree, e.g. ["--tmux"].

title.description: Terminal window title set before Claude starts. Null disables it. Tokens: {worktree} {branch} {repo} {path}

sessionName.description: Value passed to `claude --name`, which names the session and the title Claude maintains. Null disables it. Tokens: {worktree} {branch} {repo} {path}
